name: getty
description: Plugins by Getty for Claude Code and Codex — skill distribution, subagent briefing, and whatever comes next.

plugins.name: agent-irc
plugins.description: Mirrors a session's activity into IRC: prompts, tool calls with durations, subagents, token usage. One nick per session.

plugins.name: briefing
plugins.description: Programmatic briefing beats prompt stuffing. Pre-loads declared skills into a subagent's context at spawn time, so it wakes up already briefed.

plugins.name: loadguard
plugins.description: Keeps AI-issued shell commands from taking down the host: each session runs in its own systemd scope with memory and CPU limits, so a runaway command hits a wall instead of swapping the box to death. Linux only.

plugins.name: manage-skills
plugins.description: Hardlink-based skill sharing across projects — one source of truth per skill, hardlinks everywhere else. Puts the manage-skills CLI on PATH and ships its own skills.

plugins.name: skilletor
plugins.description: Remote skills, agents and rules for Claude Code and Codex — declared once in skilletor.json, synced on every session, templated per project. The preferred successor to manage-skills.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Cross-project skills for Claude Code and Codex — Perl house style and release tooling, git conventions, Kubernetes and container operations, and the craft of writing skills themselves. Only what has no single home of its own.
